response.sql: WITH leftover AS (SELECT event_status, amount - spent AS left_over FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(left_over) AS overall_avg FROM leftover), by_status AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(left_over) AS avg_left_over FROM leftover GROUP BY event_status) SELECT s.event_status, s.avg_left_over, s.avg_left_over - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM by_status s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL;
